summary: This is a prospectus supplement filed by Mingteng International Corp Inc. (Nasdaq: MTEN), a Cayman Islands holding company, under Rule 424(b)(5) for a registered offering of 457,355 Class A ordinary shares and pre-funded warrants to purchase up to 1,022,645 shares. The purchase price per share is $2.00, and pre-funded warrants are priced at $1.99995 with a nominal exercise price of $0.00005 per share. The offering is conducted pursuant to a securities purchase agreement dated June 17, 2026. A concurrent private placement includes unregistered warrants for 1,480,000 shares. Placement agent FT Global Capital Inc. receives warrants for 111,000 shares at $2.40, subject to a 180-day lock-up under FINRA Rule 5110(e)(1). This filing is an ordinary equity capital raising, not a special-situation transaction.
